title: Six arrested at protest over Abisay Cruz's death
article: Six people were arrested during a protest in St-Michel on Sunday, according to Montreal police.
Demonstrators gathered at Ovila-Légaré Park in support of 29-year-old Abisay Cruz, who died following a police intervention on March 30.

Police spokesperson Mariane Allaire Morin said officers dispersed the protest around 4:30 p.m. after some participants threw pyrotechnics onto Highway 40. While most attendees left at that point, a smaller group continued to launch fireworks into the air around 5:45 p.m.
Between 5:45 p.m. and 9 p.m., police arrested four individuals for assault with a weapon and two others for assaulting a police officer. No injuries or property damage were reported.

Allaire Morin added that the Bureau des enquêtes indépendantes (BEI) is currently investigating the circumstances surrounding Cruz's death, and police are not commenting further while the investigation is ongoing.

According to a preliminary BEI report, 911 was called after someone was reported to be in crisis near a residence. A physical altercation occurred between the individual and responding officers. The person lost consciousness and was transported to a hospital, where he was later pronounced dead.
